Hi!

Getting 100+ ad concepts a month from raw script to launch-ready, with no second check needed, takes a sharp eye on every edit and a pipeline that gets faster every week.

On the AI side, I'd help turn your references and formats into workflows you can reuse, and check AI edits as closely as human ones.
My English is at a working level (B1) and Spanish is my native language. I'm happy to do a test review of one of your first drafts.

Hi!
You need editors who can look at AI-generated videos, pick the stronger output and explain clearly why, from pacing and transitions to artifacts and storytelling.
I run LeoVisual.nl, an AI creative studio in Amsterdam. I generate and edit AI video every day, so I see the typical failures up close: flicker, warped hands and faces, broken motion, inconsistent characters and cuts that kill the rhythm.
Two examples: ORBE and SILENCIO, cinematic ads made with AI, where I did the idea, the generation in Kling and Seedance, and the edit and sound in Premiere and After Effects. I also make motion graphics and product videos for clients.
My process for each comparison: watch both outputs at full speed, then frame by frame; check continuity, composition, motion and artifacts; then write a short, structured note on which one wins and what would fix the other.
I haven't done AI training work before, but this is the same judgment I use when choosing between generations for my own projects. My working English is B1, and I'm happy to do a test task.
My rate is 25 USD/h, within your range.
How many comparisons per task do you usually expect, and is there a written rubric to follow?
